name: Jude
role: Brother of James, author of the letter of Jude
summary: Judas, named among the brothers of Jesus with James, Joseph and Simon. The letter of Jude opens with “Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James,” and urges its readers to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints, against men who have slipped in unnoticed.
body: His short letter cites the archangel Michael disputing with the devil over the body of Moses, and a prophecy of Enoch, the seventh from Adam.

moments.text: Michael and the body of Moses

later.text: Jude 14–15 quotes 1 Enoch 1:9, a Jewish apocalypse known in full only in Ethiopic, with Aramaic fragments at Qumran.

sources.title: Aramaic fragments of 1 Enoch, Qumran Cave 4 (4QEnᶜ)

later.text: Hegesippus, as quoted by Eusebius, tells how Jude's grandsons, poor farmers, were brought before the emperor Domitian as descendants of David and released.
